from pathlib import Path
import csv,json,struct,time,hashlib,collections
p=Path('.work/windows-timing-followup-20261116/etw/admin-20261116T074942-5bd67094');c=json.loads((p/'capture.json').read_text());tids={s['observer']['primary_tid'] for s in c['samples']}
raw=csv.reader((p/'raw-cswitch.csv').open());frequency=int(next(raw)[1]);clock_type=int(next(raw)[1]);next(raw)
assert frequency>0 and clock_type==1
clock=time.get_clock_info('perf_counter');assert 'QueryPerformanceCounter' in clock.implementation
targets=collections.defaultdict(list);interrupts=collections.defaultdict(list);last={};offsets=[];count=0;chain_errors=0
for r in csv.reader((p/'events.csv').open(errors='replace'),skipinitialspace=True):
 if not r or len(r)<2:continue
 try:timestamp=int(r[1])
 except ValueError:continue
 if r[0]=='DPC_ISR_CSWITCH_PCT' and int(r[7]) in tids:
  interrupts[int(r[7])].append((int(r[2]),timestamp,int(r[8]),int(r[5])))
 if r[0]!='CSwitch':continue
 q=next(raw);tick,cpu=int(q[0]),int(q[1]);payload=bytes.fromhex(q[5]);new,old=struct.unpack_from('<II',payload)
 assert cpu==int(r[16]) and new==int(r[3]) and old==int(r[9])
 offsets.append(tick*1000000/frequency-timestamp);count+=1
 if cpu in last:
  previous_tick,previous_new=last[cpu]
  chain_errors+=previous_new!=old
  if old in tids:targets[old].append((previous_tick,tick,cpu,timestamp,int(r[15])))
 else:assert old not in tids
 last[cpu]=(tick,new)
assert next(raw,None) is None and count==723767 and chain_errors==0
assert max(offsets)-min(offsets)<=1.01
rows=[]
for s in c['samples']:
 tid=s['observer']['primary_tid'];queries=s['observer']['queries'];intervals=targets[tid];di=interrupts[tid];assert len(intervals)==len(di)
 # Same Windows QPC clock. Use integer cross products to avoid float tick/ns conversion at boundaries.
 begin=queries[0]['process_query_end_ns']*frequency;end=queries[1]['process_query_end_ns']*frequency
 gross=0;excluded_min=0;excluded_max=0;partial=0;used=0
 for (a,b,cpu,timestamp,duration_csv),(dstart,dend,dcpu,d) in zip(intervals,di):
  assert dend==timestamp and dcpu==cpu and abs((timestamp-duration_csv)-dstart)<=1
  a*=1000000000;b*=1000000000
  length=max(0,min(b,end)-max(a,begin))/(frequency*1000)
  if not length:continue
  used+=1;duration=(b-a)/(frequency*1000);gross+=length
  if length<duration:partial+=1
  excluded_min+=max(0,d-(duration-length));excluded_max+=min(d,length)
 # dpc fields rounded to integer us once per slice: conservative +/-1us per used slice.
 bracket_us=sum((x['process_query_end_ns']-x['perf_start_ns'])/1000 for x in queries[:2])
 net_min=gross-excluded_max-used-bracket_us;net_max=gross-excluded_min+used+bracket_us
 api=s['cpu_us']
 rows.append({'kind':s['kind'],'tid':tid,'pid':s['observer']['pid'],'api_interval_ms':api/1000,'qpc_interval_gross_ms':gross/1000,'qpc_interval_net_lower_ms':net_min/1000,'qpc_interval_net_upper_ms':net_max/1000,'api_minus_net_range_ms':[(api-net_max)/1000,(api-net_min)/1000],'dpc_isr_excluded_bounds_ms':[excluded_min/1000,excluded_max/1000],'intersected_slices':used,'partial_boundary_slices':partial,'process_query_bracket_us':[(x['process_query_end_ns']-x['perf_start_ns'])/1000 for x in queries[:2]]})
result={'frequency':frequency,'clock_type':clock_type,'python_clock':vars(clock),'all_cswitch_raw_csv_correspondence_count':count,'raw_qpc_to_xperf_offset_range_us':[min(offsets),max(offsets)],'old_new_chain_mismatches':chain_errors,'rows':rows,'raw_decoder_source':Path('.work/windows-timing-followup-20261116/read-etw-qpc.c').read_text(),'analysis_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'raw_csv_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'raw-cswitch.csv').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'limits':['QPC boundaries use process_query_end; net bounds widened by sum of both API acquisition brackets, not an ETW marker','DPC/ISR per-slice integer us rounded; net bounds conservatively allow1us per intersected slice and partial-boundary allocation','Bounds describe rounding/allocation/bracket allowances only, not a confidence interval or total ETW accuracy bound','Header clock_type1 and QPF correspond to Windows QPC; all723767 payload old/new IDs and CPUs match xperf, offset spread<=1.01us','Same single trace, not an independent CPU clock accuracy test or calibration']}
(p/'qpc-analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
for r in rows:print(r)
